## QUILL Lite 1.1.2 — your ChatGPT plan, pictures described, and dictation

*Released September 30, 2026.*

**1.1.2 fixes Install and restart now.** Choosing it closed QUILL Lite and then nothing
happened: the small helper that waits for the app to close and then runs setup was ended
along with the app. It now outlives the app, so the button installs and restarts.

**Coming from 1.1.1 or earlier? Update by hand this once:** choose *Open folder* in the
update window and run `QuillLite-Setup-Shared-1.1.2.exe`, or download it below. Your
settings and documents are kept. From 1.1.2 on, the button works.

**1.1.1** was 1.1.0 with the version number fixed: a runtime from Quill Radio 3.0.3/3.0.4
made QUILL Lite 1.0 claim 1.1.0, so it was never offered the update. The installed
version now comes from the installer, never the shared runtime.

QUILL Lite is a free text editor for Windows built for people who use a
screen reader. It talks to you, it needs no account, and nothing you write
leaves your computer unless you ask for AI help.

**1.1 is the release where AI help runs on the ChatGPT plan you already pay
for**, and with it QUILL Lite can do two things it never could: describe a
picture, and look something up on the web. Dictation arrives in the same
release, with an AI command that corrects what the recogniser misheard. Install
it over 1.0; your settings, recent files and recovered work are all kept.

---

## AI help on your ChatGPT subscription

Press **Alt+F5** (Tools ▸ AI ▸ Use My ChatGPT Subscription), choose
**Continue with ChatGPT**, sign in the way you sign in to ChatGPT on the web,
allow "QUILL Lite" to use your plan, and come back. That is the whole setup:
no key, no allowance, no size limit, no per-request bill, and nothing passing
through QUILL's servers. The pad, the seventeen writing tools, Ask About This
Document and conversations all run on your plan from then on.

- **Pictures, described.** **Ctrl+F5** (Ask About an Image): choose a JPEG,
  PNG, WebP or GIF and either ask a question or ask nothing. You hear what the
  picture is, what matters most in it, and every word of any text in it,
  transcribed exactly. Insert Below puts the description into your document;
  Ctrl+Z takes it back.
- **Web search, one checkbox away.** Press Alt+F5, then **Alt+W** for Allow web
  search, then Space. The model may then look up an event, a price, or what a
  page says today, in Ask a general question, in a question about the
  document, and in conversations. Off until you turn it on.
- **The model is your plan's own list**, read from your account as you sign
  in; the first is chosen for you and another is saved the moment you arrow to
  it. **Open ChatGPT Usage** goes to the plan's own page.
- **Undo it whenever you like.** Sign Out (press twice) asks OpenAI to revoke
  QUILL Lite's sign-in and forgets it here; Forget on This Computer forgets it
  here only. Neither button exists until you are signed in. Only a refresh
  token is kept, in Windows' credential store; your ChatGPT password is never
  seen.

## Dictation, and dictation corrected

- **Ctrl+F11**, talk, and pause. What you said is written at the cursor with
  the punctuation put in, a soft tone confirms it, and QUILL Lite reads it back.
  Escape throws a phrase away, the microphone dropping out pauses rather than
  stops, and one Ctrl+Z undoes one phrase. Nothing you say leaves the computer;
  the recogniser ships inside QUILL Lite.
- **Tidy Dictated Text** (**Ctrl+F3**). Leave the cursor in a paragraph you
  dictated, press the key, and the model corrects what the recogniser misheard
  -- sound-alike words, a name it had never met, words run together, the comma
  that should have been a full stop, every "um" -- and changes nothing else.
  Replace My Selection puts it back; Ctrl+Z undoes it as one step. On your
  ChatGPT plan or your own OpenAI key.
